thread:
IncidentBot: PAGER: kv-cache growth detected for model=llama-2-13b-gqa (continuous-batching path). Observed KV items +220% over 12m, evictions spiking, request latency > SLO. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Severity: P2. Paging @oncall.
Jordan: oncall here, looking. which shard pool is noisy?
Maria: seeing it in dedicated-prod pool, shards 2-5. Eviction rate ~0.62 and kv_items ~1.1M on those shards. MQA variant seems to be holding prefixes longer than expected.
Devon: hmm looks like prefetch + GQA fallback is causing prefix retention blowup when cont-batch merges small requests. suspect continuous_batch_window ramped in last deploy.
InfraBot: recent deploy: config-change by config-deploy-bot at 1967999000 -> continuous_batch_window=128 (was 32) for model alias llama-2-13b-gqa.
Samir: ack. That parameter would increase KV reuse but can blow memory with high small-request fanout. propose immediate hotfix: set continuous_batch_window=32 and cap continuous_batch_size_limit=64 for that alias.
Jordan: agree. can we patch without full rollout? Canary 10% first. Maria, can you apply a config patch to the alias?
Maria: doing canary patch now to 10% of pods for alias llama-2-13b-gqa. Command: ```./rdctl config patch --model-alias=llama-2-13b-gqa --set continuous_batch_window=32 --set continuous_batch_size_limit=64 --canary=0.1```
InfraBot: executed canary at 15:12 UTC. Logs: ```[15:12:11Z] canary started pods=12/120 target=10%```
Jordan: rolling logs for the canary pods: ```tail -n 80 /var/log/serving/llama-gqa-canary.log``` snippet: ```2026-03-14T15:12:45Z model=llama-2-13b-gqa shard=4 kv_items=420k evict_rate=0.08 latency_p95=210ms``` improvement already visible on canary.
Samir: also want to toggle PREFETCH for GQA path off for the next hour while we observe. Prefetch seems to preload prefixes aggressively. Maria, can you flip it in the same canary?
Maria: PREFETCH toggled off on canary. infra command: ```./rdctl feature toggle --model-alias=llama-2-13b-gqa --feature=PREFETCH --state=off --canary=0.1```
Devon: good. if canary holds for 15m we'll roll to 50% then 100%. Also schedule a fast rollback plan if evictions spike.
Elena: customer impact assessment: initial telemetry shows 12 customers had 95th token latency > SLO for ~8m window. Most are bursty chat apps. Recommend a short support note: "We briefly degraded latency for certain bursty chat workloads while we hotfixed continuous-batching config. Mitigation applied; monitoring continues."
Jordan: canary metrics at 15:25 UTC: overall kv_items growth rate flattened, eviction rate on canary shards down to 0.05, latency p95 back under SLO. Rolling to 50% now.
IncidentBot: DEPLOYMENT: canary -> 50% at 15:27 UTC.
Maria: rolling to 50% complete. command returned success.
Jordan: rolling to 100% now with staged rollout (50% -> 100%). watching tracing and per-token cost.
InfraBot: rollout complete at 15:33 UTC across dedicated-prod pool.
Samir: monitoring shows steady state. I'll keep PREFETCH off for the next hour and then reevaluate with smaller prefetch batch.
Devon: follow-up action items: 1) adjust default continuous_batch_window change control + add chaos test for cont-batch vs prefetch combos; 2) add metric alert for kv_items per-shard > 750k to catch earlier; 3) postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.
Jordan: handing off monitoring to Maria until 18:00 UTC. Maria, take ownership for next 3 hours and coordinate with support for customer notices.
Maria: taking handoff. will update status in 30m. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: HANDOFF: Jordan -> Maria at 15:40 UTC until 18:00 UTC. Pager status: mitigated.
Elena: I'll draft the customer note and coordinate with support.
Jordan: closing pager thread but keeping this as an incident channel for the postmortem. thanks all. :heart:
